note: Every reply we have received to outreach, one row each, so the reply rate is a sum rather than a feeling. Built 2026-08-22 after Hidde asked 'hou je dit bij om van te leren?' and the honest answer was that replies lived only as loose files in drafts/. Add a row the day a reply arrives; scripts/outreach_stats.py joins this with data/outreach-sent.json.

kinds.correction: They told us something on our pages is wrong. The most valuable kind: it fixes the product.
kinds.referral: They named the right person or desk instead. Historically our best outcome per mail.
kinds.data: They gave or offered data, photographs, permission or a source.
kinds.answer: They answered a specific question we asked.
kinds.wrong_target: The address was not the organisation we thought it was.
kinds.auto: An automatic reply: out of office, ticket desk, or a press desk's boilerplate. Not a person, but it proves the address is live and sometimes tells us when to write again.

replies.gave: DUIC forwarded the pitch to the city's historical society, which is taking it up as an article in 'Op pad met Oud-Utrecht', planned for the first half of 2027.
Asked which register the Den Bosch trees came from; answered with the municipality's own 1,907-tree register.
Stood at a Den Bosch tree and could not tell which one it was. That complaint is why all eleven Den Bosch trees now carry a recognition line.

Named the tree we were missing in Porto, the Ginkgo biloba of Parque das Virtudes, and on 08-11 gave permission for his ginkgo photograph. Back from holiday end of August and promised to look for more of his own photographs then.
Answered after batch 002.

replies.org: Quercus, Nucleo Regional de Lisboa (Silvia Moutinho)
replies.gave: Congratulated the project and ASKED FOR COLLABORATION: to show the platform at one of their field events, or another joint action. That is an offer of distribution, which is the thing we have none of. Draft waiting in drafts/reply-quercus-lisboa.md.
Those trees are not theirs and they have no photographs, but he named 'the park in front of the White House', which is Lafayette Square, where we publish nothing.
Offered links and a list of ten Munster trees, which would have been a new city for nothing.
Treptower Park is run by the Strassen- und Grunflachenamt Treptow-Kopenick, not by them. That district office has still not been written to.
No photographs, no research capacity.
replies.org_correction: It is the Baureferat Gartenbau of the city of Munich, not the palace administration: Susanne Gunther is Sachgebietsleitung there. Recorded because our own note guessed wrong.

replies.gave: The Villa Torlonia cedar is officially censused and on the ministry's own monumental-tree map. The Aranciera hackberry is NOT on that list and they cannot identify which specimen we mean without coordinates, which we hold. They named Ufficio Ville and Dipartimento Tutela Ambientale as the competent offices; neither has been written to.
It is a biscuit company, not the almshouse foundation. Address and domain now on the do-not-contact list.
Named Natuur Centrum Arnhem as the desk with the tree expertise; we wrote to them the same hour.
Four sources, including the city's own tree app: nearly 1,300 monumental trees in The Hague, where we publish five. Licence still open.

Eight points. Two were errors on our pages (the Olifantsiep truck claim, the poplar's tallest-tree crown), both fixed. Also offered her foundation's centre route data and an introduction to Hans Kaljee, the city's tree consultant.
Forwarded our enquiry to Hans Erik Lund, who runs their Tree Register, and said he appreciates making Copenhagen's outstanding trees available to people who do not read Danish.

replies.org: Fundacao Mata do Bucaco (Rita Fernandes, via their biologist)
replies.gave: Their biologist confirmed all our Bucaco trees are classified of public interest, sent the information plaques and photographs by WeTransfer, and told us to REMOVE the sequoias by the Ermida de Santo Elias because nobody can walk to them. Done the same day: the trees are out, nine girths and the heights are in, three photographs live. The reply asking written permission for the plaque texts and photographs is drafted and unsent.

replies.org: Woodland Trust, Ancient Tree Inventory (Kate Lewthwaite)
replies.gave: Asked three questions and said she would discuss with colleagues: what the app is, whether it is a private individual or an institution and whether it is funded, and above all HOW WE WOULD KEEP RECORDS UP TO DATE, which she names as their main reason for not sharing data externally, because trees die and photographs age. This is the 233,000-tree register and the thread has been open and unanswered for twelve days.
Said they will come back to our questions. Nothing owed yet.
Forwarded the Platzspitz question to Gruen Stadt Zuerich, with us in copy. Warm, and no move needed until they answer.
Ten working days.
Secretariat CLOSED for the summer from 1 to 31 August. Our mail landed in a shut office.

replies.org: Asociacion Espanola de Parques y Jardines Publicos
replies.gave: Holiday closure, same as the AEA.
Boilerplate: the address is for the newsroom only and a press release may be used without notice. No human read it as a pitch.
Ticket-office autoreply.
